json.rationale: You are on a paved road (vía pavimentada) and the crossing road is unpaved. Under the rule, vehicles on a paved road have preference (preferencia de paso) over those coming from an unpaved road. No one is approaching, so you can continue.
json.temptingWrongAnswer: You must yield (ceda el paso) because you are arriving at a T-junction.
json.whyWrong: The excerpt decides it by surface, not by the junction shape: paved has preference (preferencia de paso) over unpaved, so you do not yield to the side road.
